title: SAT Practice Quiz 3
description: Fifty original USA-standard SAT-style questions: twenty-five Reading and Writing and twenty-five Math, with medium and hard questions only.

questions.question:
Although the project was praised for its speed, the evaluator warned that rapid construction had left little room for community input.

Which statement best captures the evaluator's view?
options: Effective execution came at a participatory cost
The project failed in every respect and was abandoned
Community input was plentiful and decisive
Speed was irrelevant to the evaluation
questions.correctAnswer: Effective execution came at a participatory cost

questions.question:
The review offered qualified praise, admiring the ambition while questioning the execution.

What does qualified most nearly mean?

The data were collected carefully. ___ , the sample was too narrow to support a citywide claim.

Which transition best fits?

The first text frames migration as an economic strategy; the second frames it as a search for safety.

How do the texts together develop the topic?
options: They present complementary motives for the same movement
They prove that economic factors are irrelevant
They describe two entirely unrelated population movements
They reject the possibility of shared causes
questions.correctAnswer: They present complementary motives for the same movement

questions.question:
Claim: The town's new streetlights reduced evening crashes mainly by making crossings more visible.

Which evidence best supports the claim?
options: Drivers slowed noticeably near the new lights at night
Pedestrian visibility improved at the same crossings
The lights were installed on busy roads
Crash reports declined across the whole county
questions.correctAnswer: Pedestrian visibility improved at the same crossings

questions.question:
The study was small. Its findings were consistent across sites.

Which combination best preserves both ideas?
options: Although the study was small, its findings were consistent
The study was small, its findings were consistent
The study small its findings were consistent across the sites
Consistent the findings the study was small
questions.correctAnswer: Although the study was small, its findings were consistent

questions.question:
After listing the damage, the author calls the storm 'a minor inconvenience.'

What is the effect of this understatement?
options: It creates irony by minimizing serious harm
It proves the storm caused no damage anywhere
It shifts blame onto the readers
questions.correctAnswer: It creates irony by minimizing serious harm

questions.question:
The proposal failed for a familiar reason, lack of funding.

Which revision uses punctuation correctly?
options: The proposal failed for a familiar reason: lack of funding.
The proposal failed for a familiar reason, lack of funding.
The proposal failed for a familiar reason; lack of funding.
The proposal failed for a familiar reason lack of funding.
questions.correctAnswer: The proposal failed for a familiar reason: lack of funding.

questions.question:
For years, the orchard's yield was attributed to its soil. Recent tests suggest that pollinator diversity, more than soil chemistry, explains the difference.

Which sentence best states the central idea?
options: Pollinator diversity may explain the orchard's high yield
Soil chemistry remains the sole proven cause of the yield
Recent tests have been inconclusive about the orchard
The orchard's yield has declined every year
questions.correctAnswer: Pollinator diversity may explain the orchard's high yield

questions.question:
The report offered a nuanced account, acknowledging both benefits and costs.

What does nuanced most nearly mean?

Of the two proposals, the second is more feasible.

Which revision is correct?
options: Of the two proposals, the second is more feasible
Of the two proposals, the second is most feasible
Of the two proposals, the second is more feasibler
Of the two proposals, the second is feasibler
questions.correctAnswer: Of the two proposals, the second is more feasible

questions.question:
The author contrasts a laboratory measurement with the same measurement taken in the field.

Why make this contrast?
options: To show how context can affect the result
To prove that laboratory work is always superior
To argue that field measurements should end
To replace the analysis with a personal story
questions.correctAnswer: To show how context can affect the result

questions.question:
The plan was costly. ___ , it was the only option that met the deadline.

Which transition best fits?
Where should a sentence defining a technical term go in a paragraph that introduces a problem, offers a solution, and evaluates it?
options: After the evaluation of the solution is complete
When the term first appears in the solution
At the end, as a concluding remark
questions.correctAnswer: When the term first appears in the solution

questions.question:
The majority of the samples ___ contaminated.

Which verb correctly completes the sentence?

One commentator calls the policy a modest adjustment; another calls it a fundamental break.

What best explains the difference?
options: They evaluate the policy on different scales
They describe entirely different policy proposals
They agree that the policy is minor
They both reject the policy as extreme
questions.correctAnswer: They evaluate the policy on different scales

questions.question: Which revision is most concise without changing the meaning?
options: The committee conducted a review of the budget
The committee performed a budget review
A review of the budget was conducted

questions.question:
The technician showed the supervisor a photo of her damaged panel.

Which revision makes clear that the panel belongs to the supervisor?
options: The technician showed the supervisor the supervisor's damaged panel
The technician showed the supervisor her damaged panel during the visit
The supervisor's damaged panel was shown to the technician
The technician's panel was shown to the supervisor for review
questions.correctAnswer: The technician showed the supervisor the supervisor's damaged panel

questions.question:
After the library extended evening hours, visits rose, but the librarian noted that most new visitors came for study space rather than books.

Which inference is best supported?
options: The added hours attracted users seeking space
The added hours greatly increased book borrowing
Visitors were mostly long-time library patrons
The library ended its daytime service
questions.correctAnswer: The added hours attracted users seeking space

questions.question:
The author places the counterargument at the end of the essay instead of the beginning.

What is the likely effect?
options: It lets the author's own case stand first
It proves the counterargument is irrelevant
It makes the essay harder to follow
It removes the need for evidence
questions.correctAnswer: It lets the author's own case stand first

questions.question:
The policy, which was adopted last year, remains controversial.

Which statement about the sentence is correct?
options: The commas join two independent complete clauses
The commas correct a missing conjunction
The commas mark a necessary restriction

questions.question:
Argument: Because complaints fell after the new complaint form was introduced, the form made reporting easier.

Which finding would most weaken the argument?
options: The form was introduced at several offices
Complaints were reviewed by a new manager
The old form had been widely used

questions.question:
The notes were sparse, with long gaps between entries.

What does sparse most nearly mean?

One study finds that remote work improves focus. Another finds that it weakens mentorship for new employees.

What synthesis best reflects both studies?
options: Remote work may aid focus while straining mentorship
Remote work always improves focus and mentorship outcomes
Focus is largely unaffected by work location
New employees prefer fully remote roles overall
questions.correctAnswer: Remote work may aid focus while straining mentorship

questions.question:
By next June, the team ___ the fieldwork.

Which verb form correctly completes the sentence?
If $x+y=9$ and $xy=20$, what is $x^2+y^2$?
For what value of $m$ do the roots of $x^2-6x+m=0$ have a product that is twice their sum?
Which function grows fastest for large positive values of $x$?
What is the sum of all valid solutions to $\frac{3}{x}+\frac{2}{x+1}=1$?
A circle has equation $(x-1)^2+(y+2)^2=25$. What is the length of the longest chord that lies on a line $3$ units from the center?
The median of five numbers is $14$. If the largest number is removed, which statement about the remaining four numbers is guaranteed?
options: At least two remaining values are at most $14$
The new median must remain exactly $14$ always
The mean must decrease after removal
The range must decrease after removal
questions.correctAnswer: At least two remaining values are at most $14$

questions.question: In a class, $60\%$ of students pass the midterm, and $80\%$ of those who pass the midterm also pass the final. What fraction of the class passes both?
If $f(x+1)=x^2+2x+3$, what is $f(x)$?
A $17$-foot ladder leans against a wall with its bottom $8$ feet from the wall. If the top slips down $4$ feet, how far does the bottom move from the wall?
In a right triangle, the acute angles are $A$ and $B$. If $\tan A=\frac{5}{12}$, what is $\sin B$?
Which value of $x$ satisfies $|2x+1|>7$?
When $P(x)$ is divided by $(x-1)(x+2)$, the remainder is $ax+b$. If $P(1)=5$ and $P(-2)=-4$, what is $a$?
A poll reports $54\%$ support with a margin of error of $4\%$ at the same confidence level. Which interval is consistent with the report?
A number is increased by $10\%$ and then by another $10\%$. What is the total percent increase?
A sector of a circle has radius $4$ and arc length $2\pi$. What is the sector's central angle?
What is the vertex of $y=|x-2|+3$?
Two printers working together finish a job in $6$ minutes. One printer alone would take $10$ minutes. How long would the other printer take alone?
For what value of $c$ is the vertex of $y=x^2-4x+c$ on the $x$-axis?
Which question is most likely to produce biased responses in a survey about school lunches?
options: Don't you agree the lunches are excellent?
How often do you usually eat school lunch each week?
What is your favorite lunch option?
How satisfied are you with the lunches?
questions.correctAnswer: Don't you agree the lunches are excellent?

questions.question: Two similar cylinders have scale factor $1:3$. What is the ratio of their volumes?
A line passes through $(2,3)$ and is parallel to $3x+2y=8$. What is its $y$-intercept?
A data set has mean $20$ and standard deviation $3$. If $5$ is added to every value, what are the new mean and standard deviation?
For which values of $x$ is $\frac{x-1}{x+2}<0$?
An inscribed angle intercepts an arc of $140^\circ$. What is the measure of the inscribed angle?
A mixture of sand and cement is in the ratio $7:3$. After $10$ kilograms of sand are added, the ratio becomes $3:1$. How much cement was in the mixture?
